bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 71
user="$(docker exec "$pg" printenv POSTGRES_USER)"
test -n "$user" || exit 72
cursor="$(docker exec "$pg" psql -U "$user" -d videobot -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_poll_cursor WHERE consumer_id='createvdobot'" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 73
test "$cursor" = 1 || exit 74
recent="$(docker exec "$pg" psql -U "$user" -d videobot -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_poll_cursor WHERE consumer_id='createvdobot' AND updated_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours'" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 75
test "$recent" = 1 || exit 76
pending="$(docker exec "$pg" psql -U "$user" -d videobot -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_webhook_updates WHERE status='needs_reconcile' AND updated_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '7 days'" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 77
test "$pending" = 0 || exit 78
exit 0
